carlos.title: This is Kriado
carlos.p1: Kriado Studio was born in 2026 in Mallorca as a brand of its own: hairdresser and barber for women and men, built on technical excellence, elegance and a contemporary take on personal care.
carlos.p2: Behind the brand is Carlos Kriado, in barbering since 2020 and a professional since 2022. Today Kriado is a team: Pau, a stylist, works in the salon too, and with Kriado Private the Kriado experience reaches villas and hotels across the island, with complete discretion.

about.how1: We work by appointment: pick a day and time on Yeasy or message us on WhatsApp.
about.how2: Every service has its own time, from 15 minutes to an hour and a half: you can see it on the menu before you book.

about.metaTitle: About us: hairdresser and barber in Cala Ratjada
about.story1: The barbershop has its own menu, from Kriado Essential to Kriado Experience: cut, beard, brows, wash and massage, plus bleaching to white and touches of colour. The hairdressing side covers women's cuts, colour and highlights, perms, styling and updos, and care treatments.
about.story2: Carlos started out in barbering in 2020, building his technique and his passion for men's grooming, and in 2022 he made the move into professional work. In 2026 he founded Kriado Studio in Mallorca, turning that journey into a project of his own, built on technical excellence, elegance and a contemporary take on personal care.
about.how4: We advise you before we start: every cut, colour or new look is tailored to your hair and your style.
